Find the File of a Yearly Raster Series for Given Years

Source: R/find_year_file.R
find_year_file.Rd

For a folder holding one raster per year (WorldPop, VIIRS, EDGAR, land cover), returns the file of each requested year, or of its nearest available year, with the year actually used.

Usage

find_year_file(
  path,
  year,
  year_regex,
  pattern = "\\.tif(\\.gz)?$",
  max_gap = Inf,
  iteration = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Folder of the series.

year

Integer vector of requested years.

year_regex

Regular expression matching the data year in the file names.

pattern

Regular expression the file names must match. Default "\\.tif(\\.gz)?$".

max_gap

Largest distance in years accepted for a substitute year. Default Inf.

iteration

optional character to be print before computation. Usually, it is the name of the object on which the function is applied. This is useful when the function is used inside an apply family function to keep track of the iterations.

Value

A tibble with one row per element of year: year, src_year (the year used) and file (the path, ready for terra::rast()).

Details

The data year is read from each file name with year_regex. Name the year by what surrounds it: many series also carry a release or processing year in the name (EDGAR 2025 files are EDGAR_2025_GHG_CO2_2015_...), so a bare \\d{4} would read the wrong one. Lookbehinds work well, e.g. "(?<=pop_)\\d{4}" or "(?<=CO2_)\\d{4}".

A year the folder lacks takes the nearest year it has, the earlier one on ties, unless it is more than max_gap years away; then file is NA. Check src_year against year to see which values were filled.

When a year exists both as .tif and .tif.gz, the .tif is used. A year only available compressed gets the /vsigzip/ prefix, so that terra::rast() reads it without unzipping first (slowly: it decompresses as it reads).

See also

terra::rast()

Examples

dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "series")
dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.create(file.path(dir, paste0("pop_", 2015:2020, "_1km.tif")))
#> [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE

find_year_file(dir, 2013:2016, year_regex = "(?<=pop_)\\d{4}")
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>    year src_year file                                   
#>   <int>    <int> <chr>                                  
#> 1  2013     2015 /tmp/RtmpqrI6ZE/series/pop_2015_1km.tif
#> 2  2014     2015 /tmp/RtmpqrI6ZE/series/pop_2015_1km.tif
#> 3  2015     2015 /tmp/RtmpqrI6ZE/series/pop_2015_1km.tif
#> 4  2016     2016 /tmp/RtmpqrI6ZE/series/pop_2016_1km.tif
